currentUserGoal: Fix the redesign Options menu, which was visually broken and unreliable after the DOM agent layer work.
summary: Made the agent-readable output and dormancy report truly non-visual while keeping their DOM text available to agents and tests.
Removed the focus-within CSS rule that caused the readable agent state to appear as a large debug panel after clicking Options.
Fixed the DOM music toggle state so the agent layer exposes Turn Music On when muted and Turn Music Off when audible.
Replaced the two overlapping DOM music toggle buttons with one dynamic toggle element to avoid hidden-button hit-testing weirdness.
Hardened DOM agent button activation with pointerdown, mousedown, and click fallback plus dedupe.
verification: Browser screenshot confirmed the Options modal no longer shows agent-readable debug boxes.
Browser smoke confirmed music Off -> On -> Off -> On state transitions through DOM controls, Back closes the menu, and no warn/error logs are emitted.
Browser was reset to http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign&resetMemory&skipIntro with Options closed and music on.
npm run check passed: lint, 27 tests, and build.
knownIssues: The Options panel is still minimal; it only exposes music volume/toggle and Back.
The redesign prototype still has many untracked files in the worktree, so do not use git diff alone to infer what changed.
nextRecommendedSteps: Add more real options later: text scale, reduced motion, fullscreen/window scale, and reset-memory confirmation.
Consider adding a visual-only options smoke screenshot to future browser checks whenever the DOM agent layer changes.
doNotRevert: Do not remove the DOM agent layer; it is intentional for accessibility/testing.
Do not bring back visible agent debug panels in normal play.
